item.title: Roller Coaster Add-On 1.0
item.creator: Lofi Girl
item.description:
Design your own roller coasters and jump in for the ride.

- Smart rails that auto-shape into slopes, turns, loops and rolls
- Ride your creations in an immersive POV camera that tilts and rolls with the track
- Automate it all: stations, boosts, brakes, track switches and more!
- Build a full theme park: themed blocks, animatronics, VFX & SFX
- 18+ pre-built coasters

faqEntries.heading: How do I get my first coaster?
faqEntries.content:
- Place Coaster Rail blocks to design your track.
- Add a Station Rail and link it to a Signal Remote with the Coaster Wrench.
- Place a Coaster Car on top of the Station Rail.
- Interact with the car to hop in, then use the Signal Remote to start the ride.
- Your first coaster is ready! The Coaster Car will ride along your track with realistic physics.

Check the Guidebook for more advanced mechanics to automate and decorate your coaster.

=> You can also place pre-built coasters and ride them right away with the Structure Placer.

faqEntries.heading: Are the coaster rails real blocks?
faqEntries.content:
There are two types of rails, so both answers apply!

- Coaster Rails are real, fully placeable blocks that you can walk on.
You place and break them like any other block, and they auto-connect
smoothly into slopes, turns, loops and rolls on their own when you
place them next to each other. This makes it super easy to design
your own coasters!

- Pro Rails are the second type: they let you draw free-form curved
rails for much more freedom smooth banked turns, loops and
corkscrews that follow any path you want. Unlike Coaster Rails, this
type of rail is not made of blocks; you create it by linking Coaster
Anchors together.

Both are available, use the one you prefer!

faqEntries.heading: How do I ride and change the camera?
faqEntries.content: Interact with a Coaster Car to sit. While riding, press Jump to cycle first / hood / third-person views, and Sneak to dismount.

faqEntries.heading: My camera is stuck after leaving a car. What do I do?
faqEntries.content: Open the Coaster Settings item > Debug > Unstuck, or run /roller_coaster unstuck.

faqEntries.heading: Does it work in multiplayer?
faqEntries.content: Yes. Build and ride together in the same world or Realm.

faqEntries.heading: Is this Add-On compatible with Vibrant Visuals?
faqEntries.content:
Yes - it is Vibrant Visuals enhanced. 
For the best experience, though, we recommend playing without Vibrant Visuals.

howToEntries.heading: 1. Lay your track
howToEntries.content:
Place Coaster Rails - they auto-shape into slopes, turns, loops and rolls as you connect them. They even work on floors, ceilings and walls.

You can also use the Track Placer for quick and easy rail placement.

howToEntries.heading: 2. Add a car and Ride it
howToEntries.content:
Place a Station Rail, then set a Coaster Car on the track.

Then, interact with the car to hop in. Press Jump to switch camera (first/third person), and Sneak to get off.

howToEntries.heading: 3. Automate it
howToEntries.content:
Set rails to Boost, Brake or Chain Lift with the Coaster Wrench, and use Signal Remotes and Station Rails to launch and stop trains.

To go further, wire it all with redstone, add Switch Rails to change routes, and use sensors and converters to build fully automatic, self-running attractions.

howToEntries.heading: 4. Theme your park
howToEntries.content: Restyle blocks and cars with the Coaster Brush, then decorate with themed blocks, animatronics and VFX/SFX.

howToEntries.heading: 5. Try a ready-made coaster
howToEntries.content: Use the Structure Placer to place a full pre-built coaster into your world.

howToEntries.heading: 6. GUIDE and SUPPORT
howToEntries.content:
Tip: The Guidebook has a page on every feature, and a translated version is available in 12 languages in the Coaster Settings item.
